body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~55 files / ~11,100 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample world position).

**Map sizes curated** (126 / 190-default / 254 — each just under a 64 boundary; old 200 cap wasted 21.9% on gutter). `MapSizes` swapped by reflection for the dialog's duration only; `Clamp` snaps to an offered size.

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between `RegionType.Portal` ends (stairs subclass `Building_Door`) conduct connectivity **without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**, transitively fixing storage search and every `WorkGiver_Scanner`. **We patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal** — the perf-mod compat guarantee.

**Portal regions are ONE CELL** — wormholes link every cell pair; `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M`.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site; never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder (traversal at `Pawn_PathFollower`) · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
`ScenParts` (41) spawns colonists mid-generation. **Carve runs in a `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix** (before `FinalizeInit`). Genstep-time band math uses `TryPendingSurfaceRect`. Start spot clamped at genstep 40 (+24-cell pod margin) + `RescueStrandedColonists` + full-band sweep with census + **`CarveStartClearing`** on 100%-rock surfaces (mountain-base start; verified in play).

---

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (2026-07-28 — root-caused, fix pending verification)

Reload broke everything at once (`Banded == false` everywhere: free-panning whole map, "this map has no bands"). **Mechanism — cache poisoning:** on load, `Map.ExposeData` runs `ConstructComponents()` first (fresh EMPTY `ABBandMap`) and only later deserializes the real one. Loading from a running game keeps the main thread rendering → `CameraDriver.Update` → clamp → `CompOf(Find.CurrentMap)` fires mid-load → latches the empty instance (non-null!) into CWT + memo → every later lookup returns it. The per-frame camera patches + `CompOf` front cache made an always-latent race near-deterministic.

**Fix, two layers:** (1) `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != LoadSaveMode.Inactive`; (2) `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit` (runs on the REAL instance) unconditionally `RebindAfterLoad`s every cache + drops the biome memo. Belt and braces deliberately.

**Also fixed at the same boundary:** `ABWormhole.byMap` was `Dictionary<int, List<Pair>>` keyed by `map.uniqueID` — loading neither clears statics nor fires `MapRemoved`, and the loaded map reuses the same uniqueID, so fresh maps inherited stale pair lists (second occurrence of the uniqueID-keyed-static lesson; `spikeLayouts` had it too). Both now `ConditionalWeakTable<Map,…>`; `RearmAll` prunes dead pairs. And the load-time camera move ran on the LongEvent **worker thread** where `CameraDriver.MapPosition` (Unity transform read) throws — swallowed by a silent catch, so it never ran on load; now deferred via `LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished` with map-still-current guards.

**Verification pending:** load from menu · load-while-playing (the poisoning case) · save/load double cycle · `AB2: band info` after each.

---

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / SKY VEGETATION / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell is a parameter — not the rejected ambient-latch) · sky biome locked to surface · `SeedFlora` · Biomes! Caverns basements (band-scoped carve, scribed `basementBiome`, foreign gensteps confined). Compat watch: perf-mod biome caching → `AB2: biome report` `<-- MISMATCH`. Stalagmite-leak check + Earthen Depths temp still pending.

# 4. CAMERA — verified in play
`viewBand` on the component · free pan via `CurrentViewRect` clip (memoized, gated, never degenerate) · `ABBandCurtain` draws `map.MapEdgeMaterial` at `WorldClipper` altitude (camera never clears; two hardcoded colours failed; queue beats altitude).

# 5. MAP GENERATION — profiled, ~4× faster, closed
`ABGenProfile` (vanilla's own DeepProfiler brackets, depth-counted, thread-pinned) + carve phase stopwatches. Four theories each measured; real mechanism = **crowdedness** (linear `ListerThings.Remove` per destroy; per-op 0.19→0.03 ms uncrowded). Decisive fix: `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands` (per-cell roll ⇒ safe to scope; `map.Area`-count scatterers deliberately NOT scoped). Carve 16.9 s → ~4.2 s comparable tiles. Remaining documented fat: cavern spawn-then-hollow (~1.5 s worst), RockChunks scoping.

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — measured, 96 pawns
59.6 fps vsync-pinned; mod ≈ 2% frame budget. `CompOf` front cache (immutable pair vs torn reads). Phase-skip in below-draw tried and REVERTED. `DrawDynamicThings` isolated measurement still pending.

# 7. SKY SYNC / BELOW-DRAW
Event-driven sky sync (roof beats edifice; `AB_WallTop` dontRender + `ShowsBelow` — the top of a wall IS the wall; NOT used by combat hole test); suspended during carve. Below-draw: pawns + non-pawn realtime things (`DrawThings`), all three phases unconditionally (8 vanilla types render pawns inside themselves).

# 8. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (2026-07-28, untested)

| Def | Footprint | Connects |
|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | one direction |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | one direction |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | one direction |
| **`AB2_Elevator`** | **2×2** | **every level, full mesh** |

**The counterpart rework the elevator was deferred for is done:** single scribed `counterpart` → `List<Building_ABStairs2> counterparts` (LookMode.Reference). **Old saves migrate**: legacy `AB2_counterpart` key still read, merged at PostLoadInit. `TryEstablish` loops target bands via `EstablishEnd` (find-or-spawn, footprint-sized carve, matching rotation); elevator (`linksAllLevels`) spawns a car on every other band and links the set as a **FULL MESH** — sky↔basement is one transit, not a surface hop. `DeSpawn`: destroying any member collapses the whole shaft (`collapsingShaft` latch). Gizmos: one "view level N" per end. Orders pick the end on the band the player is viewing (`BestCounterpartFor`). Metallic-only, costStuffCount 150 — buys reach, not speed (all transits are instantaneous). Graphic: `AB_Elevator.png`, `Graphic_Single` (referenced at last, after existing unreferenced since the texture landed).
Known: 2×2 = even dimensions ⇒ rotation-sensitive footprint — counterpart spawns with matching rotation (bug #2's fix covers it). `Carry` latent hole (landing exactly on realDest) still unfixed.

Stairs stall history (all resolved): door could never open (tickerType Never ⇒ `openInt` forced in SpawnSetup) · 2×2 rotation offset · landing pocket = footprint (now `ExpandedBy(LandingRadius)`) · `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach` (cardinal approaches; **`placeWorkers` REPLACES on inherit — `DoorLearnOpeningSpeed` restated**).

# 9. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · why is this pawn stuck · ABStuckWatchdog (verdict-contradiction unfixed) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile (auto).

# 10. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle) — blocking everything else.
2. **Verify elevator**: build on surface → cars appear sky + basement, `band info` shows 3 pairs full mesh, ride sky↔basement direct, deconstruct one car collapses shaft, legacy-save stairs still paired after load.
3. **COMBAT** — 575 LOC, never verified. Upward shots invisible (see-below looks down only).
4. Vertical power conduit (paired-battery lore ready) · isolated DrawDynamicThings run · compat audit · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths · transplant (coastline + mountain-window) · reachability-as-proxy audit.

# 11. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason (four gen theories wrong; per-op cost is the tile-independent number) · crowdedness drives destroy cost; don't generate doomed content · per-cell gensteps scope safely, area-count scatterers don't · reuse the engine's object (BiomeAt/CurrentViewRect/MapEdgeMaterial) · **statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak across loads AND games — twice now; key by Map object/CWT** · **loading neither clears statics nor fires MapRemoved; ConstructComponents creates a transient EMPTY component — never cache comps while Scribe is active** · FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread; Unity APIs throw there (defer via ExecuteWhenFinished) · distrust confident ordering comments · "nothing drawn" ≠ black · altitude ≠ draw order · float Color ≠ Color32 · Unity errors bypass the bridge · a green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · benchmark that surprises you is usually broken · verdicts contradicting their own data are worse than none.

# 12. PUBLISHING
Store page rewritten honestly this session (elevator/shafts/combat listed under Known Limitations — **update when elevator verifies**). known-issues.json v2 (10 entries — the no-elevator entry now stale too). Preview regenerated. Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`. Playing-gated debug actions via Debug Actions menu. New colony for banding; **reload tests need load-while-playing specifically**. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
